title: KCsMoP$_{2}$O$_{9}$ Structure
comments:
Space group \href{current_web_home_dir/hexagonal_spacegroup.html#sg170}{$P6_{3}$ \#170} is \href{current_web_home_dir/Tutorials/ChiralSpaceGroups/index.html#ClassII}{chiral, Sohncke Class II}.  A mirror reflection of this structure will put it in the enantiomorphic space group \href{current_web_home_dir/hexagonal_spacegroup.html#sg169}{$P6_{1}$ \#169}. 
 Each structure has the same energy, which orientation will form depends upon the formation process. For this reason we could have put this structure in $P6_{1}$, as (Baiheti, 2020 b, ICSD 206223) did for KCsWP$_{2}$O$_{9}$.  We chose the (Baiheti, 2020 a) description of KCsMoP$_{2}$O$_{9}$ as the prototype solely because we have fewer entries in space group \#170 in the Encyclopedia.
